A practical synthesis is to predeclare intervention strengths, metrics, history-length bins and random seeds; freeze the trained model, validation users, targets and candidate lists. Compute each user’s paired change from intact history, averaging repeated positions and perturbations within that user before category aggregation; then macro-average the four category means. Users—not positions or perturbation draws—are the sampling units. Define length strata using original nonpadding histories, report eligible-user counts, and mark impossible interventions as ineligible rather than zero-effect. This applies general paired-evaluation principles; it is not an established recommendation-specific standard. [Offline evaluation guidance](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10791-020-09371-3).

For affordable controls, precommit to, for example, 20 seeded history shuffles per user, preserving item identities, multiplicities and padding; include an identity control. Separate these diagnostic controls from inferential permutations. Cache user-level results, then obtain 95% paired bootstrap intervals from 2,000 user resamples within each category, carrying each user’s complete intervention vector together and recomputing the macro-average. These intervals condition on the fitted models and fixed candidates; they exclude training and candidate-sampling uncertainty. For hypothesis tests, use paired label swaps only when within-user exchangeability under the null is defensible. [Paired bootstrap](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html); [permutation assumptions](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.permutation_test.html).

Apply Holm correction across all prespecified confirmatory strengths, metrics and subgroup contrasts; it controls familywise error under arbitrary dependence. Report effect sizes, intervals and adjusted p-values, labeling ordinary bootstrap intervals as pointwise. Freeze diagnostic choices before inspecting outcomes: multiplicity correction does not repair adaptive validation tuning. Treat subsequent diagnostic changes as exploratory. [Holm correction](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/stats/html/p.adjust.html).
